name: EPIC 212616277

text.card: A red giant 7,781 parsecs away, 20 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.75 solar masses and 19.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,608 K at its surface.
